text:
Aisha Patel: Quick heads up — vendor sync with NVIDIA / Habana / AMD on Fri 9:00am PT. Main asks: firmware/driver windows, embargo dates for announcements, marketplace listing timelines, SI onramp blockers. Can folks post one-liners before EOD? Thanks.

Tom Nguyen: I'm in. From infra: H100/H200 kernel compat matrix ready, but seeing a potential firmware change on H200 that could shift availability by ~2 weeks. Will post details.

Lena Ortiz: For Gaudi (Habana), SI reported driver pkg v1.4.3 passed perf but breaks our quant tests. SI needs a hotfix; ETA Tue. That could delay any joint announce.

Radhika Singh: For MI300 (AMD): marketplace listing is approved but image signing requires a KMS update — security needs JIRA SEC-1123 resolved before we can publish. Raising with Sec.

Ethan Morales: Marketplace ops note: listing slotting is constrained next two weeks. If partners want a launch slot, we need firm embargo dates by Tue COB to carve windows.

Partner Bot: calendar: Meeting scheduled Fri 09:00 PT — invite sent to @Aisha @Tom @Lena @Radhika @Ethan. :spiral_calendar:

Tom Nguyen: Quick ask — SLA impact: if H200 firmware delayed beyond 2w, we may need to route customers to H100 fallback. Ops: can we advertise fallback in docs?

Lena Ortiz: Yes, we can add a fallback note. Also suggest canary rollout to 5% traffic for new drivers. cc @eng-sre

Samir Rao: Can do canary. Need an image tag naming convention. Propose `redwood-gaudi:v1.4.3-canary-2024-04-08`.

Aisha Patel: Action items: 1) Tom to post firmware diff + risk statement by EOD. 2) Lena to confirm SI hotfix ETA. 3) Radhika to open SEC JIRA and ping legal on embargo. 4) Ethan to hold marketplace slot tentatively Fri-Wed window if embargo firm. I'll consolidate and send to vendors.

Tom Nguyen: Posting firmware note: `H200 FW 2.1.7 -> 2.1.9: fixes thermal throttling; requires brief ECC toggle; rollout may require node reboots. Risk: 1-2% job restarts expected during rollout.`

Lena Ortiz: Adding SI note: `hotfix branch created: hb-hotfix/quant-fix; test pass expected Mon AM; will follow with signoff.`

Radhika Singh: SEC-1123 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1123 — KMS rotation dependency added, assigning to @security-eng.

Ethan Morales: :thumbsup: locking tentative slot. I'll follow up with marketplace PMs and send slot confirmation by Tue.

Aisha Patel: Thanks all. I'll DM partners and ask for embargo date by Tues. If no firm date, default to delayed publish and coordinate press ops. :white_check_mark:
